label: Within the scope
definition: The agglomeration is within the scope of the Directive.

label: Outside the scope
definition:
The agglomeration is outside the scope of the Directive (below 1 000 p.e.), has been
cancelled, or has merged with another agglomeration.

label: Fluctuating
definition: The size of the agglomeration fluctuates around 1 000 p.e.
